title: Promotion quote
description: What the promotion engine answers when checkout asks it to price a cart. Advisory, and short-lived.

cart-id.description: Cart this quote prices, as checkout addressed it.

account-id.description: Account the eligibility was evaluated for. Absent for a guest cart.

currency.description: Copied from the cart. Every amount in this quote is denominated in it.

subtotal.description: Cart subtotal the engine was given, echoed so a stale quote is detectable.

discount-total.description: Sum of what the applied discounts are worth. Never exceeds the subtotal.

applied.description: Discounts that survived eligibility and stacking, in the order they were applied.

items.description: Tagged union over the two concrete discount subtypes; switch on source.

rejected.description: Candidates the engine considered and declined, with the reason. Drives the basket UI copy.

fallback.description: True when the engine answered without a full evaluation, so checkout prices undiscounted.

expires-at.description: After this instant checkout must re-quote. Short by design; see ADR 0002.

rejection.description: One candidate discount that was not applied, and why.

discount-id.description: The promo or coupon that was declined.

reason.description: Closed set, because each value maps to one line of customer-facing copy.
